[Skip to main content](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback) Copy On this page ## Capabilities [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#capabilities "Direct link to Capabilities") DataGrail's HubSpot integration provides the following capabilities: | Product | Capability | | --- | --- | | [Request Manager](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/request-manager/getting-started) | | Request Types | Access,Deletion | | Identifier Categories | Email | | Field Level Controls | Access,Deletion | | | [Live Data Map](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/ldm/ldm-overview) | System Detection,Data Discovery | ## Before You Start [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#before-you-start "Direct link to Before You Start") To successfully configure this integration, please ensure you have sufficient privileges: - **DataGrail User Role:** Super Admin,Connections Manager - **HubSpot User Role:** Super Admin ## Connect to DataGrail [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#connect-to-datagrail "Direct link to Connect to DataGrail") 1. In DataGrail, select `v3` for the HubSpot **API Version**. 2. Select **Login to Configure**. 3. Using a Super Admin account in HubSpot, select **Grant access** to give DataGrail permission to use the required scopes. Required and Optional API Scopes **Required:** - `oauth` - `crm.objects.contacts.read` Depending on the integrations capabilities you've selected, additional scopes may be required: **Access:** - `content` _(optional)_ - `crm.objects.deals.read` - `crm.lists.read` - `sales-email-read` _(optional)_ **Deletion:** - `content` _(optional)_ - `crm.objects.deals.read` - `crm.lists.read` - `sales-email-read` _(optional)_ - `crm.objects.contacts.write` **System Detection:** - `crm.schemas.contacts.read` - `crm.schemas.companies.read` _(optional)_ - `tickets` _(optional)_ - `e-commerce` _(optional)_ **Responsible Data Discovery (RDD):** - `content` _(optional)_ - `crm.objects.custom.read` _(optional)_ - `sales-email-read` _(optional)_ ## Next Steps [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#next-steps "Direct link to Next Steps") Now that you've successfully connected the integration, check out the following resources: - [Access Request Lifecycle](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/request-manager/request-processing/privacy-right/access) - [Deletion Request Lifecycle](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/request-manager/request-processing/privacy-right/deletion) - [Request Manager Overview](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/request-manager/getting-started) - [Customizing Intake Forms](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/request-manager/request-intake/privacy-request-center#customization) ## Troubleshooting [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#troubleshooting "Direct link to Troubleshooting") If you are unable to successfully connect the integration, review these common troubleshooting steps: Ensure Required Permissions Are Granted on API Keys/Resources DataGrail checks required permissions and scopes on API keys/resources used by each integration. If all necessary permissions are not granted, new connections will fail. Review Required Account Types and User Roles If users do not have the necessary permissions or the minimum required user role in the connecting system, the connection to DataGrail will fail. Additionally, connections will fail if your account type does not match the one required by the integration. See [Before You Start](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/#before-you-start) to review these requirements. ## Technical Details [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#technical-details "Direct link to Technical Details") | Access Type | Synchronous | | Deletion Type | Synchronous | | Rate Limiting | **-** 50 requests / 10 seconds
**-** 125,000 requests / day (DataGrail Limit) | ## API Documentation [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/connection-instructions/hubspot/\#api-documentation "Direct link to API Documentation") Learn more about this API implementation and DataGrail functionality in our [API Integration Documentation](https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/integrations/api-documentation/hubspot). Need help?
